Tesla is currently rolling out FSD v15 and offering personal orders for the Cybercab [1, 2]. 

* FSD v15 features a new photorealistic AI rendering system and is slated for a wide release in December with the Holiday Update [1].
* Select customers can now order the driverless Cybercab for personal use at a price of $29,990 [2].
* Operating the Cybercab requires a mandatory $299 monthly Autonomy Subscription and is currently restricted to supported service areas in Texas and Florida [2].
